package provider

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	"github.com/pion/ice/v4"
	pion "github.com/pion/webrtc/v4"
)

var researchPeerID atomic.Uint64

func researchObserveSCTP(pc *pion.PeerConnection) {
	if os.Getenv("WS_WAN_DIAGNOSTICS") == "0" {
		return
	}
	id := researchPeerID.Add(1)
	go func() {
		output, err := os.Create(fmt.Sprintf("research-sctp-%s-%d.ndjson", os.Args[1], id))
		if err != nil {
			return
		}
		defer output.Close()
		encoder := json.NewEncoder(output)
		ticker := time.NewTicker(500 * time.Millisecond)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for range ticker.C {
			state := pc.ConnectionState()
			transport := pc.SCTP()
			if transport != nil {
				_ = encoder.Encode(map[string]any{
					"timeMs": time.Now().UnixMilli(), "id": id, "state": state.String(),
					"sctp": transport.Stats(), "queues": transport.ResearchQueues(),
					"buffered": transport.BufferedAmount(), "udp": ice.ResearchUDPTiming(),
				})
			}
			if state == pion.PeerConnectionStateClosed {
				return
			}
		}
	}()
}
